concept.title: Not Married Yet, Already Us
concept.human_truth: Long before vows, two people begin behaving like a unit through automatic habits, shared decisions, shared stress, real friction, and practical care that survives irritation.
concept.emotional_arc: unofficial habits -> mutual decisions -> one problem becomes shared stress -> equal friction -> care survives without erasing anger -> separate lives, already an us
concept.visual_system: Wordless Habit Relay with a broken-key continuity incident, an anger-to-care threshold turn, and a repaired-key circular payoff

slides.copy:
We’re not married yet.
But try telling that to our habits.
slides.visual: Medium-wide three-quarter doorway view from inside: both are already moving toward the exit. Aachu slips Zuv's wallet and keyring into his open near-side jacket pocket while Zuv lowers her capped water bottle into her open tote. Neither looks at the other; their anticipated pocket and tote positions make the practiced relay legible. Feet point outward, action zones sit at different heights, faces remain identity-readable, and the scene occupies the lower half under generous clean text space.
slides.cta_intent: make partners send this as recognition that everyday habits already become an us before vows
slides.pose: Aachu left/front, Zuv right/slightly behind, natural two-inch height difference, shoulders moving in the same direction without a posed embrace.
slides.wardrobe: Aachu in a light shirt and blue jeans anchored to selected identity references; Zuv in a white zip top and grey trousers anchored to selected identity references.
slides.props: Wallet and keyring at the mouth of Zuv's pocket; capped water bottle entering Aachu's open tote; one empty key hook and two pairs of shoes angled toward the exit.
slides.background: Specific apartment threshold with a slim exit console and softly faded edges; no decorative filler or people.
slides.continuity_lock: Setup for slide 11's deliberate match cut. Four visible hands must remain owned, attached, and spatially separate; no hand or object may penetrate clothing or the tote.

slides.copy:
Every plan starts with:
“Ek minute, usse poochna padega.”
slides.visual: Over-Aachu-shoulder view from just outside the threshold: Aachu is half outside with a phone at her ear, screen hidden, and gives the unseen caller a brief hold palm while turning back. Several feet inside, Zuv holds both helmets by their straps and answers with a low open information-sharing gesture, never an approval signal. Their eye-line crosses the doorway and her forward step visibly pauses.
slides.cta_intent: make partners send this as recognition that everyday habits already become an us before vows
slides.pose: Aachu foreground with one foot outside and torso twisted back; Zuv midground in a relaxed stance that does not block the exit.
slides.wardrobe: A separate montage outfit selected from identity references; do not repeat slide 1's outfit.
slides.props: Phone with screen inward and two plain helmets with no labels or text.
slides.background: Building threshold with one helmet hook and natural depth; no caller, driver, neighbour, reflection, or graphic divider.
slides.continuity_lock: Blind-read must say coordination, not permission. Exactly two visible people and four traceable hands.

slides.copy:
Every small decision becomes
a two-person meeting.
slides.visual: Wide profile from an adjacent doorway: Zuv holds a small blank frame flush against the hallway wall while Aachu stands four feet back, squinting with mock seriousness and pinching two fingers to signal a tiny lateral adjustment. Their eye-lines converge on the fractionally tilted frame, and one strip of painter's tape shows the previous position so the decision is visibly in progress.
slides.cta_intent: make partners send this as recognition that everyday habits already become an us before vows
slides.pose: Zuv in profile near the wall; Aachu in opposing profile at a useful judging distance; no couple pose or romantic gaze.
slides.wardrobe: A new montage outfit sourced from identity references; do not repeat slides 1 or 2.
slides.props: One blank unglazed frame and one small strip of painter's tape; frame contains no portrait, writing, symbols, or reflection.
slides.background: Lived hallway with one unfinished hanging point and soft paper fade; no gallery-wall clutter.
slides.continuity_lock: The adjustment action, not decoration, must carry the scene. Exactly two visible people.

slides.visual: Low lock-level close profile: Zuv freezes at the lock of an already slightly ajar apartment door, holding the bow half of a freshly snapped key three to five centimetres from the lock while the metal shaft remains unmistakably embedded. A narrow wedge of warm interior light makes the already-ajar door state explicit; his stopped turning motion, dropped eyebrows, parted mouth, and raised shoulder tension show the mishap landing on him alone.
slides.cta_intent: make partners send this as recognition that everyday habits already become an us before vows
slides.pose: Zuv alone in the lower-right, upright and naturally balanced; left arm fully outside the crop.
slides.wardrobe: Start the continuous evening wardrobe used through slide 10: Zuv in the off-white zip top and grey trousers from ID04 portrait-07.
slides.props: Two clearly separated key pieces; two helmets resting together on the ledge as evidence they were about to leave.
slides.background: Matte grey-blue apartment door and lock with no reflective hardware; body contour stays separate from door and frame.
slides.continuity_lock: Start of one continuous incident through slide 10. Exactly one visible person and one visible hand.

slides.visual: High three-quarter landing view: Aachu has arrived and searches her open tote for something useful while Zuv aims his phone torch, screen turned inward, at the embedded key. Her bag-search and his lock inspection are different subtasks converging on the same obstacle; their shoulders nearly meet and both bodies tighten around the lock without either rescuing the other.
slides.cta_intent: make partners send this as recognition that everyday habits already become an us before vows
slides.pose: Aachu left of the door and Zuv right, both upright with a slight task-focused lean; no crouching or cramped anatomy.
slides.wardrobe: Same evening as slides 4-10: Aachu in the black outer layer over a black top with blue jeans from ID01 face-04; Zuv unchanged in the off-white zip top and grey trousers from slide 4.
slides.props: Open tote, phone torch with hidden screen, detached key bow in Zuv's open palm, embedded shaft, same helmets and ledge.
slides.background: Same landing architecture and light direction as slide 4, with all solid boundaries continuous.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two visible people. Every wrist and forearm must remain traceable; no phone UI or hand disappearing magically into the tote.

slides.visual: Low-medium two-shot from ledge height: Aachu has found small closed pliers while Zuv holds his phone face-in, ready to call for help. They argue over incompatible but plausible solutions. The shoulder-to-shoulder geometry of slide 5 has opened into a two-to-three-foot gap; the detached key bow lies on the ledge and the shaft remains embedded between them.
slides.cta_intent: make partners send this as recognition that everyday habits already become an us before vows
slides.pose: Both in three-quarter profile with direct eye-line and equally irritated, restrained expressions; feet angle slightly away, no shouting, pointing, crossed arms, or saintly patience.
slides.wardrobe: Same locked evening wardrobe as slides 4-10: Aachu in the black outer layer over a black top with blue jeans; Zuv in the off-white zip top and grey trousers.
slides.props: Closed pliers held downward, phone screen hidden, key bow on ledge, embedded shaft, same two helmets.
slides.background: Same landing; door set diagonally so its seam never becomes a split-screen device or crosses either body.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two visible people and four owned, traceable hands. Both solutions must read as plausible so neither partner becomes the caricature.

slides.copy:
Then five minutes later:
“Ghar pahunch ke text karna.”
slides.visual: Wide view from just inside the apartment through the door that has remained visibly ajar since the key snapped: Zuv crosses the threshold with his helmet, leading foot committed toward the stairs. Aachu stays inside, posture still stiff, and half-raises one hand after calling to him. His feet keep their departure direction, but his head and shoulders turn back immediately and their eye-lines reconnect across the distance.
slides.cta_intent: make partners send this as recognition that everyday habits already become an us before vows
slides.pose: Aachu lower-left with both feet inside; Zuv lower-right one pace outside, no approach, smile, romantic gaze, or breakup melodrama.
slides.wardrobe: Same locked evening wardrobe as slides 4-10: Aachu in the black outer layer over a black top with blue jeans; Zuv in the off-white zip top and grey trousers.
slides.props: Zuv's helmet strap in his left hand and snapped-key half at his right thigh; Aachu's tote remains inside.
slides.background: Doorway and stair diagonal create real depth; warm interior light meets cooler corridor light without tinting the ivory paper.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two visible people. Door remains visibly ajar rather than changing state; damaged lock, clothes, helmet, tote, and architecture remain continuous.

slides.visual: Low side-medium view at catchall height: after pausing, Zuv places the snapped-key half flat into the shallow catchall just inside the doorway rather than handing it directly to Aachu. She watches the clipped return without reaching. His stair-facing foot still points away, her weight stays rearward inside, and three to four feet remain between them, so the disagreement has ended operationally but not emotionally.
slides.cta_intent: make partners send this as recognition that everyday habits already become an us before vows
slides.pose: Both unsmiling in profile with opposing torsos, no touch, embrace, crossed-arm posing, or theatrical anger.
slides.wardrobe: Same locked evening wardrobe as slides 4-10: Aachu in the black outer layer over a black top with blue jeans; Zuv in the off-white zip top and grey trousers.
slides.props: Snapped-key half moving from Zuv's right hand into the catchall; helmet remains in his left; Aachu's right hand holds her tote strap.
slides.background: Same doorway and landing with every architectural line visibly separate from heads, shoulders, backs, and arms.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two visible people and three visible hands; Aachu's left stays fully out of frame. Her gaze drops to his key hand, setting up the thumb nick on slide 9.

slides.visual: Native 3:4 eye-level tight threshold two-shot: Aachu screen-left and Zuv screen-right, upright on one plane at equal camera depth. Crop crown to lower ribs above all waists and pockets, with both bent right elbows in frame and both faces in clear three-quarter view. Exactly two arms and hands are visible. Aachu’s right shoulder-to-elbow-to-wrist-to-hand chain ends in a thumb-and-index pinch on one corner of one loose white tissue, dabbing the clear 3-mm nick below Zuv’s right thumbnail. Zuv’s right shoulder-to-elbow-to-wrist-to-hand chain ends in a half-open hand at chest height, thumb uppermost and still. Both left arms and every stray skin-toned edge stay outside the crop. Both gaze at the tissue-thumb contact with closed lips and tightened brows; no smiles. Heads stay equal scale, with Zuv’s crown only one-fifth of a head higher for the real two-inch difference. Make the contact the sharpest lower-center detail while both faces remain clear.
slides.cta_intent: make partners send this as recognition that care can survive a real fight before vows
slides.pose: Upright at equal depth on one threshold plane; no leaning, crouching, or stepping closer. Clear three-quarter faces, equal head scale, nearly level shoulders, and Zuv’s crown one-fifth of a head higher. Torsos stay 12–14 inches apart. Both bent right elbows stay inside the crown-to-lower-ribs crop; both left arms stay outside. The only contact is Aachu’s tissue on Zuv’s right thumb. No smile, hug, hand-hold, caress, maternal lean, handshake, or reconciliation pose.
slides.wardrobe: Same locked evening wardrobe as slides 4-10, visibly anchored to the selected identity photos: Aachu in the black outer layer over a black top with blue jeans; Zuv in the off-white zip top and grey trousers.
slides.props: Exactly one loose thin single-ply white facial tissue with a softly crumpled translucent edge, pinched by one corner—not a stack, cloth, handkerchief, bandage, napkin, note, towel, or bundle. One clear 3-mm terracotta-red nick sits below Zuv’s right thumbnail, non-graphic and without dripping. No other prop.
slides.background: Neutral warm-ivory paper, a soft evening doorway-light wash, and one faint door edge at the far outer frame, separate from both silhouettes. No central jamb, furniture, ledge, prop, person, reflection, or text-like mark. Keep the upper 35% clean for exact copy and the tiny top-right brandmark; action stays in the lower 65%.
slides.continuity_lock: Same black layer on Aachu, off-white zip top on Zuv, and evening threshold light as slides 4–10. Exactly two people, two visible forearms, and two visible hands: Aachu right performs the tissue dab; Zuv right presents the nicked thumb. Both left arms remain entirely outside the crop, which ends above every waist and pocket; no extra skin-toned edge may appear. Both bent right elbows stay in frame and both right shoulder-to-elbow-to-wrist-to-hand chains remain uninterrupted. Heads stay equal scale at equal depth with only the locked two-inch height gap. Reject any extra or pocket hand, tissue stack, ambiguous white object, unreadable nick, narrow or elongated face, heavy forward curl mass, exaggerated height gap, full-profile face, or central door divider.

slides.visual: High ceiling-corner extreme wide: after the tissue transfer, Aachu steps back inside while Zuv continues down the first stair turn. They travel in opposite directions. The snapped-key half remains in her catchall; the tissue now wraps his thumb; Aachu holds her face-down phone ready at her side. The architecture shows separate homes and trajectories while reciprocal residue keeps them connected.
slides.cta_intent: make partners send this as recognition that everyday habits already become an us before vows
slides.pose: Ordinary walking pace with at most one small final head-turn; no longing pose, luggage, loneliness melodrama, or celebratory romance.
slides.wardrobe: Same locked evening wardrobe as slides 4-10: Aachu in the black outer layer over a black top with blue jeans; Zuv in the off-white zip top and grey trousers.
slides.props: Key fragment stays inside with Aachu; tissue travels with Zuv; helmet in Zuv's left hand; phone screen hidden in Aachu's right.
slides.background: Doorway and stair geometry provide natural separation without a graphic divider, second doorway, extra figure, mirror, or wedding symbol.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two visible people. Figures and architecture stay below the upper third and fade into neutral ivory paper.

slides.copy:
Shaadi abhi baaki hai.
Par “hum” toh kab ke ban chuke hain.
slides.visual: Next morning, a deliberate match cut to slide 1's wide three-quarter doorway view in new reference-anchored clothes. Aachu tucks Zuv's wallet into his jacket pocket while Zuv lowers her filled water bottle into the open tote; neither needs to look and both are already moving through the doorway in sync. The previously jammed lock now has a clean replacement cylinder and one fresh working key on the ordinary hook.
slides.cta_intent: make partners send this as recognition that everyday habits already become an us before vows
slides.pose: Same directional flow and natural two-inch height difference as slide 1, with at most a tiny corner-of-mouth recognition and no embrace or posed celebration.
slides.wardrobe: New next-morning clothes selected from identity references; do not repeat the evening incident wardrobe.
slides.props: Wallet, water bottle, open tote, repaired lock cylinder, and one ordinary working key; no paired keys, rings, garlands, mandap, sindoor, nameplate, or wedding portrait.
slides.background: Same practical doorway as slide 1 with the repaired consequence visible and all decorative clutter removed.
slides.continuity_lock: Intentional match cut pays off slides 1 and 4-10. Exactly two visible people and only two active hands, each with clean wrist attachment and unambiguous front/behind order.

copy.caption_recommended: No vows yet. Bas habits ne thoda jaldi decide kar liya. 🤍
copy.caption_alt: Officially, not married. Unofficially, every plan, problem, fight and check-in already comes in plural.

visual_setup: Native Instagram post carousel only, 1080x1440. Premium observational-intimacy watercolor-and-ink on neutral warm ivory paper with visible grain, never yellow or parchment. Track object ownership and body distance. Slides 1-3 are separate habit receipts in different reference-anchored outfits; slides 4-10 are one evening at the same apartment landing with one locked wardrobe; slide 11 is the next morning. Reserve clean upper-middle negative space for exact integrated copy and isolate the tiny top-right @a.storyof.two brandmark. No background people, portraits, reflections, silhouettes, duplicate figures, random text, UI, wedding symbols, or generic posed couple posters.
